name: SIERRA

description.short: 2-way strapless gown in shimmering organza that transforms from mermaid to A-line.
description.full:
Pricing & Availability

  • Made to Order: ₱21,500
  • Custom size available

Details

  • Style: 2-Way Strapless Mermaid to A-Line
  • Fabric: Shimmering Organza
  • Color: Pearl White
  • Design: High-shine, modern, and versatile

Features

  • 2-Way Design: Features a detachable full skirt, allowing you to switch from a grand A-line to a sleek mermaid silhouette.
  • Draped Bodice: Elegant horizontal pleating across the chest for a clean, structured look.
  • Shimmer Finish: Made with premium organza that catches the light with every move.
  • Fit and Flare Base: The inner mermaid dress hugs the curves for a sophisticated reception look.
  • Adjustable Back: Lace-up detail ensures the bodice stays secure and perfectly fitted.

Add-on

  • Lace Cathedral Veil: Hand-detailed lace veil available as an add-on to complete the classic look.

priceMessage: Message us on Facebook for inquiries on custom measurements or to start your order!
